_note: SYNTHETIC mock flags for building the auditor console against before the real radar exists. Matches the Flag shape in KABADI_KHATA_SCOPED_DOWN.md §3.1. The real /radar/run replaces this. 38x is our simulated case, not a CPCB finding.

flags.explanation_en: Recycler C claimed 190 t for Sep 2026 but only 5 t of verified inflow traces to it — a 38x gap. Deterministic mass-balance rule R1.
flags.explanation_hi: Recycler C ne Sep 2026 mein 190 t claim kiya, par sirf 5 t ka verified maal milta hai — 38 guna farak. Rule R1 (mass balance).

flags.explanation_en: 10 receipts feeding Recycler C reuse only 3 near-identical photos (perceptual-hash cluster). Rule R2.
flags.explanation_hi: Recycler C ko jaane waale 10 receipt mein sirf 3 milti-julti photo baar-baar aayi hain. Rule R2.

flags.explanation_en: A receipt's weight was edited directly in the store; the hash chain breaks at seq 9. Rule R3.
flags.explanation_hi: Ek receipt ka weight seedha store mein badal diya gaya; hash chain seq 9 par toot gayi. Rule R3.
